hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */platform/*.ts|*/platform/*.tsx) cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/platform" && pnpm exec prettier --log-level warn --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; pnpm exec eslint --no-warn-ignored --max-warnings=1000 "$f" 2>&1 | tail -20 ;; esac; exit 0
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/platform" 2>/dev/null && if git diff --quiet -- . ; then exit 0; fi; pnpm exec tsc -b tsconfig.build.json 2>&1 | tail -15; exit 0
